admission.justification: Consolidation puts procedures with different powers in one skill, so the boundary has to hold in both the closeout workflow and the quality-control workflow that now share a home.

applicability: The consolidated skills that now carry both a diagnostic procedure and its sibling authorship or worktree procedure.
conditions: Each procedure keeps its own powers and states them where it lives.
A diagnostic procedure does not acquire authorship or transaction authority by consolidation.
exclusions: Splitting the consolidated skill back into one skill per procedure.
statement: Consolidated skills distinguish diagnostic/closeout procedures from their sibling authorship/worktree procedures without contradictory powers.
